name: Delivery Type 4 Code
definition: Describes the delivery or custody arrangement for the underlying foreign exchange.

TRIP.name: Triparty
TRIP.definition: Indicates that a custodian bank or international clearing organization acts as an intermediary between the two parties to the repo.

PVSP.name: Payment Vs Payment
PVSP.definition: Indicates that the delivery is a Payment versus Payment.

HOIC.name: Hold In Custody
HOIC.definition: Indicates that the collateral pledged by the (cash) borrower is not actually delivered to the cash lender. Rather, it is placed in an internal account ("held in custody") by the borrower, for the lender, throughout the duration of the trade.

FREE.name: Free
FREE.definition: Indicates the delivery is free of payment.

AGPM.name: Against Payment
AGPM.definition: Indicates that the delivery is against payment.
